verdict.rationale: Greptile documents an official CLI (`greptile onboard`, `greptile review`) that sets up the org and runs full PR reviews with confidence scores, diagrams, and test generation in ~60 seconds, and explicitly positions it for agentic use ('Coding agents can use the greptile cli to review their own code'). This is well-documented first-party functionality with a dedicated docs page and probe confirmation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification specifically of the CLI (community evidence covers the web product, not CLI usage) and no public API/OpenAPI spec surfaced for deeper CLI-adjacent automation.
